items.headline: Kent State hosts Ball State in MAC play
items.description: Ball State (1-2) at Kent State (1-2), Sept. 26 at 12 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Smith sets Ohio State career receiving mark as 6th-ranked Buckeyes roll past Kent State 59-3
items.description: — Jeremiah Smith became Ohio State's career receiving yardage leader, Ja’Kobi Jackson scored twice and the sixth-ranked Buckeyes rolled to a 59-3 victory over Kent State on Saturday.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 2: Oregon ducks onto list
items.description: Strange happenings continue in college football, where long losing streaks have become a winning formula.

items.headline: No. 6 Ohio State shifts focus to Kent State after devastating loss at Texas
items.description: — Ohio State is on to Saturday's game against Kent State, even though most fans of the sixth-ranked Buckeyes are still fuming about last Saturday's 24-23 loss to No. 1 Texas.

items.headline: DeShields has 3 TDs, defense dominates second half, Kent State tops Wofford 36-15
items.description: — Dru DeShields threw for a touchdown and ran for two more scores, and Kent State dominated the second half for a 36-15 win over FCS Wofford on Saturday.
